title: Other components: symbols and what they do

spans.text: A potentiometer adjusts resistance, a photoresistor responds to light, a relay switches contacts, and a fuse opens the circuit on excess current. NTC and PTC thermistors change resistance with temperature; inductors store energy in a magnetic field.

spans.caption: Other components: symbols and what they do

spans.text: A symbol shows a component's role; its datasheet specifies voltage, current, and power limits. Never bypass a fuse with wire or power a motor directly from a microcontroller pin.
